comment: Default mod set: the build installed on the headset on 2026-11-11. A manifest only: no mod files, no game files, no private paths.
Mods come from Nexus Mods (your own account, personal use; see docs/SETUP_SKYRIM.md): python3 tools/vxrt_build.py mods-fetch, then mods.

nexus.md5 pins the exact archive. nexus.file_id is null until recorded (python3 -I tools/nexus.py files skyrimspecialedition MOD_ID lists the ids and md5s); with an API key the file id is looked up from the md5 at fetch time (printed so it can be recorded here); the Downloads-folder fetch matches by md5.
Load order of the plugins in the built pack: Lit Road Signs.esp, Skyland Watercolor - Slow Green-Vanilla.esp, higgs_vr.esp, SkyUI_SE.esp, vrik.esp (by priority).

SKSE VR core: the skse-core entry takes sksevr_1_4_15.dll from the official archive (not redistributable: your own download, checked by md5, from the Downloads folder). The stub module and the capture of the plugins' code patches are made for your plugin set by python3 tools/vxrt_build.py skse-capture (runs the game on the Mac for a few minutes) and are picked up by the next mods build; a skse_runtime section in your own copy of this list (core, hooks, capture: file paths) overrides them.

recipe.note: the FOMOD's own defaults: every option of a SelectAny group, the first (preselected) option of an exclusive group; tools/fomod_auto.py

external.note: not on Nexus; only the 85 compiled scripts are used (no DLL, no loader, no Source)
the same archive as sksevr-scripts; only the core DLL is used (private, never redistributed; it goes to the app's overlay root, not into Data)

mods.name: SkyUI VR 1.2.2
mods.note: the SkyUI VR plugin embeds a Lua VM whose computed jumps go through a table filled at run time: aot.sweep makes every instruction start of its code section an AOT root

mods.name: SkyUI VR: LuaJIT off (strict AOT cannot run generated code)

recipe.note: tools/skyui_nojit.py: SKSE/Plugins/SkyUI-VR/MainEntry.lua with 'if jit and jit.off then jit.off() end' in front of SkyUI's own file; priority 51 beats SkyUI's 50 in the merged tree

mods.name: owned diagnostic: list the game's plugins at DataLoaded
